# The Pinus Resort, Pahalgam

> Pine-wood cottages in Nunwan, Pahalgam (Jammu and Kashmir, India), opposite the Yatra frisking point, PIN 192126. Tagline: "A home in the heart of pines".

- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 97977 80774
- Email: thepinusresort@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thepinusresort/
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/j27WY7z7Fkgz3n3t7 (33.993931, 75.3169933)
- Bookings: enquiry form at https://thepinusresort.com/reservation/ ; the team replies by phone or WhatsApp with availability and rates. Rates are on request.

## Pages
- [Accommodation](https://thepinusresort.com/accommodation/): pine-panelled Deluxe Rooms with carved wooden ceilings and attached bathrooms with hot water; two-storey cottages; shared lounge.
- [Deluxe Room](https://thepinusresort.com/accommodation/deluxe-room/)
- [Experiences](https://thepinusresort.com/activities/): bonfire evenings, forest walks, trout fishing on the Lidder (permit needed), day trips to Aru Valley and Betaab Valley, winter snow.
- [About](https://thepinusresort.com/about/)
- [Contact and directions](https://thepinusresort.com/contact/): about 95 km from Srinagar airport, about 2.5 km from Pahalgam market.

## Quick answers
- Rates: on request; they change with the season.
- Booking: no online payment; send dates via the form, call or WhatsApp, and the team confirms.
- Deluxe Room: pine-panelled walls, carved khatamband-style ceiling, double bed, electric kettle, attached bathroom with glass shower and hot water geyser.
- Bonfire area on the lawn, on request.
- Check-in from 2:00 pm, check-out by 12:00 noon.
- On-site restaurant (Indian food); breakfast continental, Asian or buffet; room service; 24-hour front desk; tour desk.
- Free private parking on site.
- Children of all ages welcome; no cots or extra beds. Pets and parties not allowed. Non-smoking rooms.
- Rooms also have a tea and coffee maker and a work desk.
- Fishing in the Lidder needs a J&K Fisheries Department permit.
